run_tod_distributed_uber_script: run the tod_distributed_uber_script to train, evaluate, and run model-model chats for task-oriented dialog
run_get_mm_opt: run get_mm_opt to build model-model chat options with api schemas and grounding settings
run_concat_conversations: run concat_conversations to merge multiple JSONL conversation files while deduplicating dialog entries
run_eval_class: run eval_class to select between EvalModel and DistributedEval based on SLURM environment
run_train_class: run train_class to select between TrainModel and DistributedTrain based on SLURM environment
